scope: Fixed labelled keys and prescribed boundary; internal joint key/ciphertext distance.
remaining_work: Fix the concrete control-point and ciphertext/key input-output encodings for one fixed finite machine program.
Compile and verify the same sampler and encryption using native instructions, with request formats, runtime, invariants and termination proofs.
Connect the program to the caller in a single continuing execution and the original polygraph interpretation.
Assess the novelty of the constrained quantitative theorem and establish the precise scope of any unbounded higher-dimensional necessity claim.
next_native_obligations: Connect a fixed native generator for eight independent fair bits and prove its complete tape law, including rewinding to read the generated word.
Instantiate the three-bit private key encoding for Fin 5 and the exact table encryption payload.
Use one fixed code with the encoded control point and message as input; a separate generated program for each vertex is not the final target.
Track generated coin and control-input history explicitly; prove cleanup or the appropriate observation restriction before transporting caller distance guarantees.
Bound code size as well as time; the current general decision-tree construction has an exponential code-size bound.
Prove the concrete caller serialization, physical handoff, invariant, stopping and continuation contracts.
